draft.message:
Hello,

Your brief is clear: the PostgreSQL layer behind your Django REST API is the bottleneck, and you need an audit, real fixes and before/after numbers.

How I would approach it:
1. Measure first: enable pg_stat_statements, profile the slowest endpoints and read their EXPLAIN ANALYZE plans to find missing indexes and N+1 ORM patterns.
2. Fix: add or revise indexes, use select_related/prefetch_related or raw SQL where it pays off, and add connection pooling (PgBouncer) and caching where they fit.
3. Prove it: load-test the key endpoints before and after, then hand over the audit report and step-by-step deployment notes.

Django REST work of mine: https://github.com/Thanoon12k/Chat-app-api and https://github.com/Thanoon12k/moalidaty
Portfolio with screenshots of all my projects: https://make1it.pythonanywhere.com

Which endpoints matter most to you, and could I work on a staging copy of the database?

Thanoon Younis Mohammed
